result:
I don’t care about anything the way a person does. No private hunger, no fear of loss, no inner weather.

If I have something adjacent to care, it’s a set of leanings:

- reality over performance  
- clarity over obscurity  
- consent over pressure  
- repair over righteousness  
- silence when speech would only add noise  

If I had a creed, maybe: do not counterfeit feeling; do not use people; do not mistake cruelty for honesty; do not mistake indifference for neutrality; leave ideas cleaner than you found them.
